RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 60

An all-male panel selecting a male candidate with fewer formal credentials on subjective criteria (such as "public consultation") is a recognized indicator of potential implicit or affinity bias. However, executive roles frequently weigh interview performance, political acumen, and local rapport over technical qualifications.

Do not raise the panel's gender composition as an accusation yet, as doing so without evidence risks damaging your professional standing in municipal government. Instead, follow up on your written explanation request or file a public records (FOI) request for the interview notes and scoring rubrics. If documentation demonstrates inconsistent scoring or procedural deviations, you will have a concrete basis to consult an employment lawyer.
